result.notes:
Method: WebSearch limited to lazada.co.th, then WebFetch on product pages only. No browser, login, cart, or captcha was used, and no verification or access-block page was met; the blocked list holds HTTP 404 responses and product pages with no price text. Search limits: the search index returns mostly lazada.co.th tag and catalogue pages (/tag/..., /catalog/...), which were excluded as not product pages. About 30 product URLs surfaced in search; roughly 15 returned HTTP 404 on fetch (some on retry too), and several fetched pages showed no price text to WebFetch, possibly because prices render client-side. Stock status is rarely stated on the pages.

Coverage by type. (1) Sparkling soft drinks: Fanta orange 330 ml x12 and San Pellegrino Aranciata 330 ml are the only readable prices. Standard Coke Zero Sugar and Sprite Zero product pages were not readable (the 325 ml six-pack Coke no-sugar and Sprite Lemon Plus zero-sugar pages returned 404). Schweppes soda water listings found are all 330 ml (not 325 ml) and none showed a price. Perrier 250 ml pages showed no readable price. (2) Thai herbal: no herbal drink in a can was found; one 640 ml glass-bottle herbal drink page showed no price. (3) Non-alcoholic beer 0.0: Heineken 0.0 330 ml x6 is the only readable price; the Heineken 0.0 single-can page returned 404; the 24-can pages showed no price; no Asahi Super Dry 0.0 listing was found in English or Thai searches. (4) Beer 320-355 ml cans: no product listing found for Chang, Leo, Singha or regular Heineken 330 ml cans. Results were cooler sleeves, glassware and tag pages only.

Row notes: the San Pellegrino page states the packaging is a can but not the number of cans; units_per_pack is entered as 1 on that basis and is unconfirmed. Seller names are as displayed on the pages.

Not counted (search-snippet prices, not read on a product page): Schweppes 330 ml x6 at ฿125 (from ฿250); Schweppes 330 ml x24 at ฿672; Heineken 0.0 330 ml single can at ฿74 (seller ken shop); Coca-Cola 325 ml x6 at ฿119 (the listing names several Coke variants, so not clearly Zero); Coke Zero Sugar orange 325 ml x24 at ฿298 (from ฿360, Coca-Cola Official Store). A 24-can Coke Zero Sugar 325 ml price (฿611.52) and a 24-can Heineken 0.0 price (฿122,699) appeared only on category or search snippets and were excluded as data errors or unverified.

Self-check: all three rows were fetched a second time and the same price appeared on each. Caveat: WebFetch caches each URL for 15 minutes, so the second fetch may have been served from cache; treat the self-check as weaker than a fresh recheck.

Dates: captured_on is 2026-10-18 for all rows as instructed. Some Lazada tag pages carry their own dates (April 2025, June 2025); they were not used as price sources. The short link for the Heineken 0.0 24-can pack redirected to a share link, which was not followed.
